agent.problem: This fill-in-the-blank asks the baker to supply the exact wording of an unseen line from the psalm. The preceding story card only says that some people take a turn, so completing "crooked" tests recall of wording rather than meaning the baker can reason out.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
